shortcuts.action: The focused window on its own
Split the current window with a new Finder window

other_interactions: Double-click a window title bar: frame that window; again to go back
Double-click the Desktop: frame the Desktop
Drag a window title bar to a screen/window edge: dock it, neighbours make room
Drag the gap between docked windows: resize
Drop a window on the middle of another and pause: create a tab group
Click a window green button: toggle docked/floating (⌥-click keeps macOS zoom)
⌘⇧-drag a rectangle: zoom to fit; Esc cancels
Quit: every window returns to a visible position

plans.free: docking, floating, zooming; up to 5 docked windows per macOS desktop
plans.pro: unlimited docked windows, tab groups, saved views, commands by URL

permissions.optional: Screen Recording (still pictures of window contents; nothing recorded)
permissions.note: Screen Recording takes effect after the app reopens.

platform: Apple silicon (arm64), macOS 14 Sonoma or newer
